scribbles.text: She says that everything goes through the messages API at Anthropic?  Is it just one API for basically everything?  Then it gets routed?  We'll see I guess.
Anthropic chose to refactor their code base in Rust
Anthropic is trusting the models to know how to code in Rust. They don't actually have that many rust engineers... should we be scared? Yikes.

It's a little concerning that Anthropic is fine with their engineers only understanding things at a high level and not being able to entirely read the code.  Especially as we trust them more and more with our data.
